authority: Owner 2026-09-27: answer 14 (missions need the same depth as the case files), answer 15 (Claude weaves the narrative, the owner greenlights), 'Go ahead' on The Thursday Load G1-G7.
fiction_boundary: Composite people and situations. The good is abstract (DESIGN_LOCKS §9.1). Families keep their own ground: the McCormicks at Siltanen and Linjat, the Jade Lantern front at Hakaniemi; Piritori belongs to nobody.

thread.title: The Thursday Load
thread.premise: Somebody on Piritori is selling the same Thursday load to both families. The vans are theatre; the load rides the 3.
thread.culprit: Kello, the Piritori watcher who times the square by the trams

missions.title: The Paper Bag
missions.premise: The first pack, bought on Piritori and sold at the bank queue. The cleanest job of the week. While Aatami waits, one man stays on the square through two trams.
missions.plants: Ask who keeps watching and the seller names him: Kello.

missions.title: Three Vans
missions.premise: Toko counts vans and never asks. Three every Thursday, one always empty. At Brahenkenttä the vans turn where they always turn, and the empty one never opens its doors.
missions.plants: Watch the tram instead of the vans, and you see where the load really goes: onto the 3, in a pram full of radios.

missions.title: The Bear Path
missions.premise: Two McCormick buyers wait at the granite bear for a Thursday load that is not coming. They think Aatami is the delivery, or the robbery.
missions.plants: Name the empty van and they understand: somebody sold them air. The fight is avoided, and the McCormicks start looking for the seller.

missions.title: The Courtyard Receipts
missions.premise: Mei Lan at the Hakaniemi front holds a duplicate invoice: both families paid for one load. The receipts that prove it lie in a Torkkelinmäki courtyard, and the Jade Lantern's people have come for them.
missions.plants: The receipts are in Kello's handwriting, the same torn-card hand as the first price on Piritori.

case.title: The Thursday Tram
case.opening: Thursday. Aatami rides car 41 of the 3 with the man in the fur hat, who nods as if they had always been colleagues. At Kurvi the pram gets on, heavier than a pram. At Piritori, Kello is waiting on his square with his cheap watch, and a very good excuse.
inspectables: the fur hat counting the load in

cut.note: Owner, 2026-09-28 (item 2): the cut pays every week, with the growing risk the pitch promised. In the seven-day slice every night is a week of Kello's Thursdays compressed: he pays at each night's settlement, and each payment makes it likelier a family finds out.

choices.label: Sell Kello to the McCormicks
choices.detail: A large payment and a friend in the family. The Jade Lantern will treat you as the leak, and Kello leaves the square.

choices.label: Take a cut and keep quiet
choices.detail: €60 now and €30 every night after, counted on the square. Each payment makes it likelier a family finds out.

choices.label: Take the tram route over
choices.detail: The pram and car 41 carry for you now. The first load is yours; the route is a risk from here on.

choices.label: Give it to Toko
choices.detail: No money. He never asks, but now he knows, and he trusts you with what he hears.
